description: Add a mohist/push action and wire it into the default workflow's integrate stage so merged commits reach the remote base branch.

tasks.title: Implement and register mohist/push action
tasks.spec: specs/git-push-action/spec.md#Requirement: git-push-action pushes the current branch to a remote, specs/git-push-action/spec.md#Requirement: git-push-action is registered in the runner action registry
tasks.description: Add a pushAction function in packages/runner/src/actions/registry.ts that reads target (default current branch) and remote (default origin) inputs, invokes git push <remote> <target> via the shared git runner, and returns task failure with combined git output on rejection. Register the action as mohist/push in createDefaultRegistry.
acceptanceCriteria: pushAction exists in packages/runner/src/actions/registry.ts and uses the module-level git runner
Default remote is origin and default target resolves to the current branch when not provided
Failed push returns status failure with git combined output included in the failure evidence
tasks.notes: Follow the existing mergeAction pattern for git invocation and failure formatting. Keep the action in registry.ts per design decision 1.

tasks.title: Add unit tests for mohist/push action
tasks.spec: specs/git-push-action/spec.md#Scenario: Default push to origin, specs/git-push-action/spec.md#Scenario: Push to configured remote, specs/git-push-action/spec.md#Scenario: Push target branch, specs/git-push-action/spec.md#Scenario: Push failure is terminal, specs/git-push-action/spec.md#Scenario: Pure git operation
tasks.description: Add tests in packages/runner/tests/push.spec.ts that mock the shared git runner via setMergeGitRunnerForTest and verify pushAction handles default inputs, explicit target/remote, successful push, and terminal push failure with git error output.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests verify git is called with push origin <current-branch> when no inputs are provided
Tests verify explicit remote and target are passed to git push
Tests verify successful push returns status success
Tests verify rejected push returns status failure and includes git error output
All runner tests pass and the shared git runner is reset in afterEach
tasks.notes: Mirror the merge.spec.ts pattern. Export pushAction from registry.ts if it is not already exported.

tasks.title: Add integrate:push task to default workflow
tasks.spec: specs/workflow-definition/spec.md#Requirement: Integrate stage declares integrate:push as the final delivery task
tasks.description: Update packages/server/src/Mohist.Server/Issue/Services/WorkflowProfiles/mohist-default.workflow.yaml to add an integrate:push task immediately after integrate:merge and before the health:integrate check. Configure it to use mohist/push with target set to ${{ project.baseBranch }}.
acceptanceCriteria: integrate:push is present in the integrate stage tasks list
health:integrate check remains ordered after all integrate tasks
Workflow YAML parses without syntax errors
tasks.notes: Use explicit target: ${{ project.baseBranch }} for clarity even though the action defaults to the current branch.
